import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    if k > 1:
        order = 1
        power = k % p
        while power != 1:
            power = (power * k) % p
            order += 1
        times = (p - 1) // order
        result = pow(p, times, MOD)
        print(result)
    elif k == 1:
        result = pow(p, p, MOD)
        print(result)
    elif k == 0:
        result = pow(p, p - 1, MOD)
        print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
